source.description: Custom Unity meshes; companion to CityGen3D OSM study, not an automatic OSM reconstruction. Fictional house.

speech.text: It's just a sprain. The neighbors called an ambulance.
speech.instructions: female, middle-aged, moderate pitch, american accent, Direction: Warm, matter-of-fact reassurance to her worried daughter. Gentle falling cadence. No punchline..

speech.text: I'm charging now. Send me the revisions. I'll look at them on the way.
speech.instructions: female, young adult, moderate pitch, american accent, Direction: Distracted work call, brisk and conversational..
female, young adult, moderate pitch, american accent, Direction: Quietly stunned after a bump. A little embarrassed..
female, young adult, moderate pitch, american accent, Direction: Hopeful, slightly embarrassed, speaking to the mechanic in the doorway..
male, young adult, low pitch, american accent, Direction: Confident, warm, gently teasing. A small smile, not a big punchline..

speech.text: Ben Kreider. You borrowed my truck for the homecoming parade.
speech.instructions: male, young adult, low pitch, american accent, Direction: Relaxed, grounded confidence. A small amused smile, not eager or awkward..

speech.text: The plow bent your rear suspension. You can’t drive it like this.
speech.instructions: male, young adult, low pitch, american accent, Direction: Plain, clear explanation. Calm competent mechanic, not dramatic..

speech.text: The part gets here December twenty-ninth.
speech.instructions: male, young adult, low pitch, american accent, Direction: Matter-of-fact, reassuring. Normal conversation, not a punchline..

speech.text: The twenty-ninth? I promised I'd be back for New Year's Eve.
speech.instructions: female, young adult, moderate pitch, american accent, Direction: Brief surprise, then worried about the promise she made. Natural conversational emphasis..

speech.text: Well, you’re not going anywhere today.
speech.instructions: male, young adult, low pitch, american accent, Direction: Warm, low male voice. Matter-of-fact but gently amused, not parental or patronizing..

speech.instructions: female, young adult, moderate pitch, american accent, Direction: Sudden recognition. Curious and warm, a small pause after Wait..

speech.text: I don't really fit here anymore. Everyone still thinks I'm seventeen.
speech.instructions: female, young adult, moderate pitch, american accent, Direction: Confiding, slightly self-conscious. A small rueful smile on seventeen..

speech.text: I know, but things will be better in the new year, when this project finishes. And yes, I'll be there for the New Year's Eve party.
speech.instructions: female, young adult, moderate pitch, american accent, Direction: Reassuring the person on the phone, trying to convince herself too. Warm, tired, conversational..
